newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX to raise natgas spread margins Friday.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX to raise natgas spread margins Friday.

text.p: The New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) will increase inter-month spread margins involving the spot Henry Hub natgas futures contract as of the close of business today, NYMEX said Friday in a statement.
The margin will be raised to $2,300 from $1,500 for clearing members; to $2,530 from $1,650 for members; and to $3,105 from $2,025 for customers.
The outright margins for the February and March, 1997, contracts will remain at $6,300 for clearing members; $6,930 for members; and $8,505 for customers.
